zh.title: 同一段话的三个版本：拦下换皮口号
zh.desc: 先划掉开头的对话寒暄与铺垫套话，再抓出“不是……而是……”反转口号，最后保留分级处理动作和 45 秒真实指标。
zh.alt: dislop 检查上线说明：划掉 AI 寒暄、拦下换皮口号、保留 45 秒指标通过检查

en.title: Three states of one note: catching rewritten slogans
en.desc: Strikes the leftover chat greeting in red, flags the 'Not X, but Y' slogan in blue, and ends clean with 12 minutes and 500,000 rows intact.
en.alt: dislop 3-state proof: flagging chat greeting, catching rewritten slogan, passing clean with 0 issues

zh.title: 命令行门禁：本地离线检查
zh.desc: 在本地运行 npx dislop check，命中 AI 残留硬伤直接返回退出码 1 拦住提交，清理套话后返回退出码 0。
zh.alt: dislop CLI 本地离线检查：原稿返回退出码 1，清掉寒暄与套话后复检返回退出码 0

en.title: Offline CLI gate: block chat leftovers in CI
en.desc: Runs npx dislop check locally: leftover chat wrappers return exit code 1 to block CI, and the cleaned file exits 0.
en.alt: dislop CLI offline check: exit code 1 on draft and exit code 0 after cleanup

zh.title: 浏览器工作台：零上传本地检查
zh.desc: 直接在当前浏览器标签页内贴稿，切换样本并对照正文标记与右侧批注，原稿不上传服务器。
zh.alt: dislop.com 浏览器离线工作台操作：切换原稿、换了种 AI 味与改干净版本

en.title: Browser workbench: local check with zero uploads
en.desc: Paste a draft on dislop.com to inspect inline marks and margin notes directly in your browser tab.
en.alt: dislop.com browser workbench capture: checking draft, rewritten slogan, and clean copy

zh.title: 网页与组件检查：清掉紫粉渐变与假按钮
zh.desc: 扫出 HTML/CSS/JSX 里的默认渐变标题、口号徽章、胶囊堆叠和 href="#" 空链接，保留 18 ms 真实查询指标。
zh.alt: 网页组件模板味排查：标出紫粉渐变、胶囊标签墙与空链接，改为保留 18 ms 指标的干净卡片

en.title: Web UI check: strip gradients and dead links
en.desc: Flags purple-pink gradients, prompt-echo badges, pill walls, and dead href='#' links while keeping the 18 ms latency metric.
en.alt: UI template slop check: flagging AI gradient, pill wall, and dead href='#' control, then showing clean benchmark card

zh.title: Word / PPT 检查：揪出裸星号、字墙与自动缩字
zh.desc: 本地解包 .pptx 检查未渲染的 **星号**、单页字墙、68% 自动缩字与过程式标题，改成结论先行的结构化页面。
zh.alt: dislop 检查 quarterly-review.pptx：标出裸 Markdown、字墙、缩排和过程标题后改为结论页

en.title: Slide check: catch raw Markdown and shrunk text
en.desc: Unpacks .pptx slides locally to flag raw **markdown** leaks, word walls, 68% autofit shrink, and topic-only titles.
en.alt: dislop auditing quarterly-review.pptx for markdown leaks, word walls, autofit shrink, and topic-only titles

zh.title: 编码 Agent 闭环：读 Skill、增量门禁与事实账本
zh.desc: 写前读取纯文档 SKILL.md，提交前用 --changed 拦下 PR 寒暄与复读摘要，改完用 dislop verify 核对数字零丢失。
zh.alt: Agent 闭环终端记录：加载 SKILL.md、增量门禁返回退出码 1、修复后通过 dislop verify 事实核对

en.title: Coding agent loop: Skill, diff gate, and fact ledger
en.desc: Agent loads SKILL.md, gates changed PR files with exit 1, and runs dislop verify to confirm all numbers survive the edit.
en.alt: Agent workflow terminal transcript: loading SKILL.md, PR diff check exit 1, and passing dislop verify
